growth_summary.method: Per chain: old shares*(new rate-old rate) + (new shares-old shares)*new rate. Share effect uses the ending mark. Not measured external deposits or an attribution of strategy profit.

fees.fee_history_scope: Ethereum Accountant only; Optimism fee history not reconstructed
fees.note: Claim payments are fee withdrawals, not strategy gross income, investor losses or operator net profit. Fee units are not added across different tokens. Run rate assumes unchanged NAV/fee and excludes downstream fees and operating costs.

borrowers.note: Discovery captured after T. At most ten largest positions per selected market; not a holder census or complete borrower census. Debt is gross debt, not depositor equity. Market and position requests are asynchronous, so coverage is a diagnostic rather than an exact reconciliation.
